errorCodes.meaning: No election with this identifier exists for this community, or the caller may not see it (CONVENTIONS §7).
Voting in the election is not open: it has not opened yet, has closed, or the election was cancelled (CONVENTIONS §7).
The election's manifest sets `allowEarlyClose` to false.
The ballot box did not answer. The election is unchanged at the community; the same request may be sent again.
The ballot box refused to close the election. Its own code and message are carried in `details`.

ElectionId.description: An election's identifier, unique within its community. A closed alphabet: it appears in the ticket class label `voter/<electionId>` and is framed into every hash a cast is bound to.

schema.description: An administrator closes voting in an election early, where its manifest allows it; the community has the ballot box close the board. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why voting is closed early, for the community's audit trail and its members.
